description: Lightning near a spot in the US right now, from NOAA's GOES-East weather satellite: the nearest strike in the last 15 minutes (distance, direction, how long ago), counts within 10 and 30 miles, and the 30-minute rule clock. Gives one sentence to say out loud, e.g. 'Lightning 6 miles west, 3 minutes ago.' Use it when someone on the water, at a ballgame, a beach or a campsite asks about storms or lightning.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

place.description: Or a Florida boat ramp name / place_id from boat_ramps

name: lightning_near
title: Lightning nearby
